See batch02 private receipts. Darker browser-render facial/material exposure than source previews flagged for visual QA; no production approval. Source archive count unchanged. Cloud remaining-source pilot group0 acquired 10 original avatars into five Drive-verified nested transport packs; 93 original avatar sources remain. No new GLB conversion or visual signoff. FINAL ACQUISITION 2026-11-13 local (2026-11-14 UTC): 103 further original sources obtained in 11 cloud batches (group4 had one filename whitespace issue fixed by isolated retry) and archived to original private Drive originals. 52 new transport-pack files, 65 originals-folder objects total; all 115 stable source IDs have private archive references. Source SHA256/Git blobs verified pre-upload, Drive provider filename/size/MIME/parent readbacks passed. Historical Medical_Female_01 source FBX-only; 105 sources have no GLB yet; only 10 GLBs smoke tested and none production approved. Master retrieval records are in private Drive, not public repo. Batch03: 10 additional distinct full-texture source models converted to GLB in GitHub-hosted Ubuntu, actual Chromium Three.js 0.185.1 WebGL2 loader/mixer/render/dispose/reload plus 20 PNGs; pre-upload source/GLB SHA256 and provider Drive metadata verified. 20 browser smoke GLBs cumulative; 95 source-only remain. 93 source-complete models queued/running in 11 cloud groups; no success asserted pending provider readback. No visual production approval. FINAL CONVERSION CHECKPOINT 2026-11-14: 10 batch03 + 93 group conversion + 1 historical delivery = 104 new GLBs, added to ten earlier browser-tested originals, making 114 Chrome/Three.js r185 GLB smoke-pass models. All new GLBs have recorded original source hashes, 2 actual Chromium PNGs per model, independent structure proof, and private Drive metadata readbacks; NO human visual signoff, mobile hardware test, or sustained GPU memory proof. Medical_Female_01 remains blocked by missing textures in historical FBX-only source. No Mac used and no demonstration files modified. Earlier '10 GLB/105 remaining' notes are historical snapshots. FINAL verified completion: Medical_Female_01 historical FBX-only ZIP remains preserved, exact pinned official seven TGAs and both FBXs plus preview/unchanged MIT license archived in separate additive complete-source ZIP. Blender/GLB2/Three.js r185 real Chromium WebGL2 tests passed, source and new GLB downloaded back from Drive with matching full-file SHA256. All 115 models now have browser-smoke-tested GLBs; still zero production visual/mobile/lifecycle approvals. See private completion receipt.
